description: This file declares the QuicChaosProtector class, which is responsible for adding chaos protection to QUIC crypto frames by building data packets with padding and reordering frames. It is part of the QUIC core implementation in the Chromium project.

classes.name: QuicChaosProtector
classes.description: A class that adds chaos protection to QUIC crypto frames by constructing data packets with padding, frame reordering, and crypto data manipulation.

methods.name: QuicChaosProtector
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the chaos protector with a crypto frame, padding, packet size, framer, and random generator.

methods.name: BuildDataPacket
methods.description: Attempts to build a chaos-protected data packet, returning its size or nullopt on error.

methods.name: WriteStreamData
methods.description: Writes stream data, as part of the QuicStreamFrameDataProducer interface.

methods.name: WriteCryptoData
methods.description: Writes crypto data, as part of the QuicStreamFrameDataProducer interface.

methods.name: CopyCryptoDataToLocalBuffer
methods.description: Allocates buffer and copies crypto data into it.

methods.name: SplitCryptoFrame
methods.description: Splits crypto frames into multiple frames to represent the same data with padding adjustments.

methods.name: AddPingFrames
methods.description: Adds random PING frames to frames list and adjusts padding.

methods.name: SpreadPadding
methods.description: Adds padding frames randomly between other frames.

methods.name: BuildPacket
methods.description: Serializes frames into a packet buffer using the framer.
